title: Fear of playing on boats
summary: Palmer disliked playing on boats because he cannot swim.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did you ever play on any boats? I played a couple of jobs on a boat, but I didn't like it. I was afraid of the boats. I played a couple of dances on there. I remember even going up and down in the water, just thinking about that boat sinking.
I can't swim either. No, me either, I can't.
Me either, I can't. That's why I wouldn't bother a good job.
I was raised on Mississippi River Tree, a camp in Missouri, right over there, but I never liked to swim. Some of those boats used to come to our town.
